newsitem.title: USA: Worthington to build processing plant.
newsitem.headline: Worthington to build processing plant.

text.p: Worthington Industries Inc. said Thursday it planned to build a $150 million flat rolled steel processing facility in Decatur, Ala.
Worthington Chairman and Chief Executive John McConnell said the operation is expected to create more than 200 jobs.
Sales at the plant, Worthington's largest such facility to date, are expected to exceed $400 million at capacity, the company said.

Worthington is a leading manufacturer of metal and plastic products, with annualized sales of $1.8 billion. It operates 55 facilities in 22 states, Canada, France, Mexico and China and has 10,000 employees.
Columbus, Ohio-based Worthington's stock rose 62.5 cents to $21 on Nasdaq at midday.
